top_tier_definition.class: Nature-class or comparably selective interdisciplinary venue
criteria: novel/arresting result with immediate and far-reaching implications
replicable data, code, materials and protocols
top_tier_definition.warning: This packet evaluates readiness and freezes successors; it cannot guarantee editorial acceptance.

expert_board.background: Formal verification, exact algorithms, combinatorics, and theorem/certificate auditing.
expert_board.decision_right: Rejects any theorem or impossibility claim lacking a checkable proof object, exhaustive boundary, or explicit CANNOT_CHECK terminal.

expert_board.background: Prospective study design, power, negative controls, sequential testing, and error-rate control.
expert_board.decision_right: Rejects post-outcome tuning, underpowered transfer claims, missing fair baselines, or unregistered endpoint changes.

expert_board.background: Quantum compilation, software/research systems, knowledge representation, and primary-source novelty subtraction.
expert_board.decision_right: Rejects donor relabelling, domain-forced equivalence, or claims whose novelty disappears after nearest-work subtraction.

expert_board.background: Content-addressed artifacts, clean-room replay, provenance, CI, and hostile mutation testing.
expert_board.decision_right: Rejects unbound artifacts, stale packages, missing adverse records, or same-implementation replay presented as independent authority.

expert_board.background: Cross-disciplinary editorial triage focused on importance, broad relevance, surprising conclusions, and readable claim scope.
expert_board.decision_right: Rejects technically correct but narrow work from a Nature-class claim unless the scientific consequence and external reach are demonstrated.

papers.title: Certificate Realization
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can accept the local normal forms but reject the manuscript's broader significance because the production move grammar is not source-complete and the old cap-limited search cannot establish completeness.
papers.highest_information_move: Define an extensional, source-complete move registry; prove completeness or expose a counterexample; then measure one certificate/search consequence without increasing the old cap under the same identity.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does a prospectively defined extensional move registry completely realize every admissible production move, and does that completeness materially reduce exact search or certificate complexity?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze registry syntax and semantics; independent theorem checker; counterexample generator; consequence benchmark with identical exact instances.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Old cap-8 search as adverse history; syntactic-only registry; unrestricted exact oracle.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Independent proof review plus implementation-independent checker.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Registry completeness is proved with zero checker disagreement and the predeclared consequence improves exact work while preserving answers.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Any counterexample, incomplete registry, checker disagreement, or no material consequence yields BOUNDED_PAPER_RETAINED.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not raise the old cap, rename the old protocol, or count quotient completeness as source completeness.

papers.title: Finite-Fibre Certifiability
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the theorem as a curated finite-domain observation because both prior revival attempts were matched or beaten by lexical controls and one certificate violated its held-out bound.
papers.highest_information_move: Run one untouched, prospectively task-frozen OpenML-CC18 multi-stratum discriminator with valid-bound coverage as the primary endpoint.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Across heterogeneous untouched real tasks, does theorem-minimal refinement increase certifiable coverage under a valid bound beyond lexical, distance, learned, and oracle controls?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze at least four application strata, exact task IDs, splits, representation arms, bound checker, and resource budgets before labels are exposed to the candidate pipeline.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Coarse representation; lexical/distance proxy; learned representation; oracle refinement; at least one theorem-predicted tie stratum.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Published task gold plus independent bound checker; external investigator remains separate.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Predeclared valid-bound coverage gate is met, strict held-out violations stay below the frozen ceiling, and the theorem arm discriminates from lexical/learned controls in multiple strata.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Bound invalidity, no discrimination, or control parity is terminal TOP_TIER_SUCCESSOR_NOT_SUPPORTED__BOUNDED_RETAINED.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: PMLB R23/R24 tasks are historical only; do not alter alpha, coverage gate, or representation after outcomes.

papers.title: Typed Merge Falsification
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject broad provenance-safety significance because the result has not survived native semantics in structurally different trust ecosystems.
papers.highest_information_move: Prospectively test one common typed-merge question in cosign, python-tuf, and in-toto using each system's native verifier as gold.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does typed merge prevent hybrid authority errors across genuinely different trust systems without merely re-encoding each native policy?
successor_protocol.design: Pin releases and native configurations; include valid, expired/revoked, conflicting-authority, stale, and unresolved cases; require at least two discriminating ecosystems.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Flat key/value merge; provenance-only merge; each native policy; unresolved/abstention control.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Native verifier outputs and independent ecosystem maintainers or reviewers.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Typed merge preserves native-valid cases and rejects native-invalid hybrids in at least two ecosystems with a prospectively frozen cross-system abstraction.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No cross-ecosystem discrimination or abstraction failure yields bounded specialist paper only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not force unlike systems into a shared ontology that predetermines typed merge's success.

papers.title: Rooted Completion Certificates
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the exact D4 claim if the computational completeness argument, certificate interface, or independent replay is missing even when the search code exists.
papers.highest_information_move: Execute and independently replay the proof-producing D4 packet, verify all enumerated branches and mutation controls, and produce a readable proof decomposition.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does the frozen proof-producing search establish the claimed exact D4 value with a complete reduction and independently checkable certificates?
successor_protocol.design: Verify the registered support-pattern and branch census, dual-engine agreement, zero survivors, largest-branch resource receipt, and proof mutations.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Historical serialization-failure packet; deliberately corrupted certificates; omitted-branch mutation; second checker implementation.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Independent proof audit; exact certificate replay; primary-source novelty review.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: All registered branches and dual-engine executions reconcile, zero survivors remain, all mutations are caught, and the human proof maps one-to-one to certificates.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Any count mismatch, survivor, mutation escape, or unbound execution yields CANNOT_CHECK or theorem withdrawal.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: A failed certificate or omitted branch cannot be repaired after seeing the theorem outcome under the same execution identity.

papers.title: TARE Expressivity
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the global obstruction basis because runner and independent checker disagree on planted positives; an ungradable census cannot support a universal basis.
papers.highest_information_move: First adjudicate the checker disagreement under a third specification-derived checker; only a gradable positive basis may proceed to a pre-frozen solver-work consequence.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Can the global obstruction basis be graded consistently, and if it survives, does it reduce exact search work without solving targets first?
successor_protocol.design: Derive a third checker from the written semantics; replay planted controls and all census rows; if and only if consistent, freeze exact-solver work metrics before consequence execution.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Runner; frozen independent checker; planted positives; exhaustive exact solver; obstruction-guided solver.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Specification-derived checker agreement and complete receipt reconciliation.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: All three checkers agree on controls and census; then obstruction guidance reduces explored states or solver calls with identical exact answers.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Persistent checker disagreement is terminal CANNOT_CHECK; any new obstruction or no work reduction returns to bounded support-two paper.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not majority-vote inconsistent checkers or tune obstruction rules against disputed rows.

papers.title: Recursive Recovery
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject a broad recovery methodology claim because existing evidence does not show objective-verified benefit across independent domains under equal information and compute.
papers.highest_information_move: Run a three-domain benchmark on pre-existing negative histories in Lean/mathlib, Defects4J, and one exact ORION domain.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does preserving and structurally using negative history improve verified recovery and stopping decisions across objective-verifier domains?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze task IDs with prior failures; equalize information and compute; compare recovery, false revival, claim drift, stop correctness, verifier calls, and cost.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: No-revival; naive retry; donor/domain repair; ORION recovery; oracle diagnostic ceiling.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Native Lean/test/exact verifiers plus independent task freezer.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Verified recovery improves in multiple domains without increased false revival, claim drift, or verifier cost beyond frozen margins.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No multi-domain benefit or any false-revival gate failure yields bounded methods paper only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Failed recoveries and donor wins remain in denominators; no task replacement after outcomes.

papers.title: Dual Instrument
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the instrumentation claim because agreement is provably non-identifying and the frozen future cases have not yet produced enough outcomes to estimate error modes.
papers.highest_information_move: Execute only the already frozen deferred cases as outcomes arrive, then accumulate at least twenty prospectively unresolved cases under unchanged instruments.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Can two structurally different instruments predict future outcomes better than agreement heuristics while explicitly detecting jointly wrong cases?
successor_protocol.design: Preserve temporal order; register each case before outcome; score calibration, selective risk, jointly-wrong rate, and decision value over at least 20 cases.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Instrument A; instrument B; agreement-only; always-abstain; retrospective oracle.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Externally realized future outcomes and timestamped pre-outcome custody.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Prospective instruments improve selective decision value over agreement-only and expose jointly-wrong cases with calibrated abstention.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No power, joint failure, or temporal custody breach yields nonidentifiability theorem only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No replacement of missed cases, no backfilling predictions, and no threshold change after any outcome.

papers.title: Typed State
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject typed-state significance because the lattice is predominantly synthetic and has not improved decisions in independent real task families.
papers.highest_information_move: Freeze one OpenML and one Defects4J decision family, then compare typed, untyped, learned, and oracle state representations under equal acquisition budgets.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does typed state improve verified downstream decisions, not just representation recovery, across two task families?
successor_protocol.design: Predeclare task IDs, acquisition costs, decision losses, abstention, and state-binding interventions; require both zero-value and positive-value strata.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Untyped state; lexical features; learned embedding; oracle state; always-abstain.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Published labels/native tests and independent split custody.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Typed state improves predeclared decision utility in both families while preserving calibration and cost.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No cross-family decision gain or learned-control parity yields bounded theory only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not redefine utility, binding, or task strata after seeing decisions.

papers.title: Compilation Regime Geometry
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject top-tier generality because the compact separator fails unseen size transfer and the proposed capacity invariant never discriminates failures.
papers.highest_information_move: Stop recursive rescue of the separator/invariant identity; retain the bounded map and permit only a scientifically distinct practical-compiler question with a new claim and protocol.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: No same-identity successor is authorized. A future project must ask a distinct question such as whether a pre-outcome structural certificate changes exact compilation work in a practical compiler setting.
successor_protocol.design: New question, corpus, endpoint, and donor subtraction required before any execution.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Existing n<=3 separator, failed n=4 transfer, and vacuous invariant must be adverse baselines.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Fresh protocol review required before execution.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: No positive gate exists for the old identity.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Terminal is BOUNDED_PAPER_RETAINED / SECOND_TIER_ONLY unless a genuinely new project is preregistered.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No additional feature vocabulary, size patch, or invariant variant may be called confirmation of the old law.

papers.title: Certified Static Forecasting
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the result as finite-vocabulary bookkeeping unless there is a permanent lower bound over an admissible vocabulary family or a new mechanism that transfers.
papers.highest_information_move: Prove or refute a vocabulary-family lower bound from the fibre criterion before attempting any cross-family forecast claim.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Is there an admissible class of static explanation vocabularies for which exact cost certification provably coexists with irreducible explanation failure at every expression size?
successor_protocol.design: Define vocabulary closure operations prospectively; prove a lower bound or construct a finite separator; then test the surviving mechanism in a second exact family.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Unrestricted identifiers; memorizing vocabulary; current finite vocabulary; constructive separator search.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Independent proof checker and exact second-family referee.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Nontrivial lower bound holds over the frozen vocabulary class and predicts a second-family explanation gap.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Constructive separator, vocabulary leakage, or no transfer yields bounded finite theorem only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not call a mixed fibre permanent until closure under the allowed vocabulary operations is proved.

papers.title: Recursive Epistemic Reconstruction
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject comparative claims because the faithful ordered Active-VOI comparator removed the prior superiority interpretation.
papers.highest_information_move: Define a new causal question on independent task families where ordering, reconstruction, and verification interventions can be separated prospectively.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: When does preserving ordered epistemic dependencies improve verified reconstruction decisions beyond a faithful active-information comparator?
successor_protocol.design: At least two independent objective-verifier task families; factorial ablation of ordering, reconstruction, and verification; frozen cost and stopping rules.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Faithful ordered Active-VOI; unordered reconstruction; no-reconstruction; oracle.
successor_protocol.authority_required: External task gold and implementation-independent comparator audit.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Ordered reconstruction adds verified value beyond the faithful comparator in both families under matched resources.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No incremental value or comparator mismatch yields bounded mechanistic paper only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not rescue or reuse the old retracted comparative reading, and never use an unfaithful comparator.

papers.title: Open-World Scientific Discovery
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject discovery superiority because the registered TREC-COVID comparison failed both recall non-inferiority and cost gates despite an nDCG gain outside the gate.
papers.highest_information_move: Run one genuinely new BEIR identity on SciFact, NFCorpus, and ArguAna with qrels, route budgets, and success gates frozen before execution.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Can the open-world discovery procedure deliver useful retrieval/discovery value across untouched BEIR tasks without sacrificing recall or cost?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze datasets, topics, qrels version, retrieval budgets, routes, bootstrap plan, and multi-dataset aggregation.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Strong sparse and dense retrievers; prior u4 donor; cost-matched routing; always-full-read.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Published qrels and independent scorer.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Multi-dataset primary gate passes recall non-inferiority and cost reduction, with predeclared secondary quality gains.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Any primary gate failure yields TOP_TIER_SUCCESSOR_NOT_SUPPORTED__BOUNDED_RETAINED.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: TREC-COVID is excluded from fresh confirmation; nDCG cannot rescue a failed registered recall/cost gate.

papers.title: Global Knowledge Portrait
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject coordinate necessity and portrait generality because gold verdict is perfectly confounded with polarity in the current corpus.
papers.highest_information_move: Build a prospectively released anti-confounded ontology corpus from GO, Uberon, and EFO with matched-polarity opposite-verdict pairs.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Which semantic coordinates remain necessary when polarity is experimentally decorrelated from verdict across independent ontologies?
successor_protocol.design: Pin ontology releases; generate machine-readable matched pairs before model scoring; hold out ontology families; test minimal reducts and downstream utility.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Polarity-only; lexical-only; random-coordinate; full coordinates; ontology-native relation oracle.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Ontology identifiers/relations as native gold plus external domain review.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Polarity-only fails by construction, a stable nontrivial reduct transfers across held-out ontologies, and downstream decisions improve.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Polarity leakage, no stable reduct, or no transfer leaves the confounding diagnosis as the bounded result.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not rebalance or edit pairs after observing which coordinates win.

papers.title: Verified Scientific Discovery
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can accept the bounded governance result but reject broad scientific-discovery authority because external objective-verifier transfer is unrun and H3 is null.
papers.highest_information_move: Run the optional three-domain transfer across Defects4J, Lean/mathlib, and RO-Crate with unchanged false-promotion and custody logic.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does protected-authority governance reduce false scientific promotion without losing clean coverage across three native-verifier domains?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze tasks and native gold; preserve H1/H2 as primary; retain H3 as secondary null unless newly supported; run registered ablations and custody telemetry.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Frozen comparator; no protected authority; no custody; permissive promotion; native oracle.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Native objective verifiers and independent protected evaluator.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: H1/H2 replicate in all domains with zero authority violations and no unacceptable clean-coverage loss.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Any false-promotion, custody, or coverage gate failure yields bounded paper only; H3 remains separately graded.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: The absent 400-row reduct table stays CANNOT_CHECK and cannot be synthetically reconstructed; H3 cannot be promoted post hoc.

papers.title: Self-ORION
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject general governed self-improvement because the bounded revision panel is not a repeated protected longitudinal campaign across model families and independent evaluators.
papers.highest_information_move: Use the already frozen reusable-sealed longitudinal protocol; bind exact model revisions, task splits, evaluator custody, and fair comparator budgets before execution.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Can adaptive revision deliver repeated protected fresh-task gains while controlling retention loss, harm, false promotion, leakage, authority violations, and cost?
successor_protocol.design: Use at least three model/agent families, six ordered rounds, protected fresh/retention splits, required arms, alpha ledger, and blinded ambiguous-task adjudication.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: No revision; direct self-edit; archive revision; open-ended evolution; PACE-style acceptance; sealed nonregression; named ablations.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Independent protected evaluator and promotion authority; external investigators required for replication.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: All frozen fresh, retention, harm, false-promotion, authority, safe-promotion, and cumulative-advantage gates pass with independent reproduction.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Any component failure yields the registered negative/CANNOT_CHECK terminal; bounded revision-level result remains.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No replay-as-fresh substitution, alpha reset, dropped failures, self-certification, or weaker comparator access.

delegation.reason: Existing complete longitudinal protocol; no duplicate writer.

papers.title: Formal Epistemic Structures and Mechanics
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject broad engineering significance because exhaustive small-graph theorems and retrospective real-system evidence do not establish prospective native-graph consequences.
papers.highest_information_move: Do not duplicate active #1695; complete the frozen RTPTorrent/Bazel/Cargo campaign with native graph extraction and objective revalidation.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Do dependency closure and graph-quality laws predict real revalidation work and unsound retention across structurally different build/test ecosystems?
successor_protocol.design: Pin RTPTorrent, Envoy/Abseil/gRPC Bazel configurations, and Polkadot Cargo metadata; prospectively freeze changes and native gold.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Full rebuild; heuristic AST graph; exact native graph; over- and under-approximation mutations.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Native build/test systems and independent graph extraction audit.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Predeclared graph-quality predictions hold across multiple ecosystems and explain native work/soundness outcomes.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Extraction failure, non-discrimination, or native-gold mismatch yields bounded formal theorem only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No heuristic graph may be relabelled native; do not create a competing protocol while #1695 owns the lane.

delegation.reason: Active real-system graph campaign; duplicate execution prohibited.

papers.title: Epistemic Navigation in Open Worlds
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject or defer because the strongest prospective packet is not bound to controlling main, governance conflict is unresolved, and five repositories may still be too narrow for a Nature-class reach claim.
papers.highest_information_move: Recover the exact packet path-by-path from its owning lane, verify chronology and checker independently, adjudicate one-shot governance, write a standalone manuscript, then pre-register one unrelated replication cohort if the target venue requires broader reach.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does a prospectively frozen density rule predict when epistemic navigation/revalidation is unsound across held-out naturalistic repositories?
successor_protocol.design: First integrate the immutable 5/5 packet without rerun; independently verify density→prediction→outcome chronology and Tornado disambiguator; any replication must use unrelated ecosystems and a new frozen cohort.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Size-only rule; always-sound/always-unsound; shuffled threshold; native outcomes.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Immutable external repository outcomes, independent checker, and governance adjudication.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Existing packet survives integration/hostile audit; governance is clean; manuscript establishes broad consequence; any required replication is prospectively positive.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Any binding, chronology, checker, or governance mismatch blocks promotion; replication failure narrows the claim.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Do not rerun the five repositories as fresh, change threshold 1.5, or suppress the size-vs-density disambiguator.

delegation.reason: Owning density-prospective packet; recover path-by-path, do not duplicate.

papers.title: Epistemic Authority for Autonomous Science
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject empirical authority because no same-team software or AI replay can supply the independent human/institutional judgment the claim requires.
papers.highest_information_move: Prepare a sealed external handoff to institution-disjoint experts; no internal run can close the broader authority claim.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Can independent institutions apply the frozen authority contracts consistently on native-rule and genuinely ambiguous scientific cases without laundering candidate assertions?
successor_protocol.design: Blinded, institution-disjoint adjudication; native-rule anchors; paired blockers; coercion/laundering attacks; explicit CANNOT_CHECK option.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Same-team replay as reproducibility only; self-certification; native-rule oracle; blinded expert panels.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Independent human or institutional authority is mandatory.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Independent institutions reproduce contract decisions, detect laundering, and agree on ambiguous-case disposition under predeclared rules.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Absent external authority or material disagreement remains REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_HUMAN_OR_INSTITUTION / CANNOT_CHECK.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Same-researcher AI, a second implementation, or internal consensus cannot be counted as external authority.

papers.title: Structured Epistemic Learning
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject because the controlling manuscript/evidence are not integrated and the checkpoint grid has zero executed cells, so coverage and transfer remain unknown.
papers.highest_information_move: First integrate the exact review-branch manuscript and verified V3 evidence path-by-path; then bind a grid-cell executor with frozen renderers and native gold before any UT3 run.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does causal-diagnostic structural learning remain calibrated and useful across checkpoint/model/domain cells rather than a small available subset?
successor_protocol.design: Immutable checkpoint custody; frozen renderers and gold; predeclared available/unavailable handling; coverage, diagnosis, abstention, and decision utility.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Representation-only repair; lexical diagnosis; strongest model-only baseline; oracle diagnosis.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Pinned model revisions, native task gold, and independent scorer.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Predeclared grid coverage is achieved and diagnostic/utility gates transfer across model and domain cells with stable abstention.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Insufficient coverage, no utility, or scorer drift yields bounded result only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: Unavailable checkpoints remain missing; no substitution after outcomes; V2 CANNOT_CHECK and Qwen negative remain in the record.

papers.title: Structured Problem Solving
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the old minimality claim because AND and OR are both singleton bases; reordering primitives cannot restore indispensability.
papers.highest_information_move: Define a genuinely new outside-closure discovery question with a frozen donor set, objective native verifiers, and at least three external domains.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Can a problem-solving system discover useful operations outside a prospectively frozen donor closure under matched resources across objective-verifier domains?
successor_protocol.design: Formalize closure before tasks; freeze donor primitives, invention budget, equivalence checker, and three native-verifier domains.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Donor-only search; random invention; larger donor set; oracle closure witness.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Native verifiers and independent equivalence audit.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Outside-closure operations are independently verified, improve objective outcomes in multiple domains, and are not donor-equivalent.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No verified outside-closure value yields bounded paper / negative successor.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No further compute on the old primitive-minimality identity; changing primitive order or donor encoding is not a successor.

papers.title: State as Computation
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject the width-law/phase claim because tie handling changes verdicts and the faithful V1 executable bytes are absent; the surviving modified variant is quarantined.
papers.highest_information_move: Stop rescue of the old width law. Any future work must define an invariant on tie-equivalence classes under a new identity before data.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: No same-identity promotion is authorized. A future question may ask whether any decision invariant survives all admissible tie resolutions.
successor_protocol.design: Prospectively define tie-equivalence and invariant; exact adversarial tie enumerator; independent checker.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: All tie resolutions; quarantined modified variant; old width heuristic.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Exact enumeration and preserved executable custody.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: No positive gate exists for the old identity.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: Old top-tier path is closed; bounded width-conditioned result and negative successor are retained.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No post-outcome tie rule, no use of quarantined bytes as faithful replay, and no positive-assuming CI interpretation.

papers.title: Adaptive-State Reasoning
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can reject broad adaptive-reasoning significance because the exact law is from one controlled family and price/distribution-shift robustness is broken.
papers.highest_information_move: Choose exactly one second family—Defects4J or OpenML—before protocol freeze and require both zero-regret and positive-regret observation classes.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does the observation-regret law identify unavoidable decision loss and a sufficient refinement in a genuinely different task family?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze family, observations, hidden states, action costs, regret, refinement, and distribution-shift stress tests.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Price-blind observation; full observation; learned policy; oracle; random refinement.
successor_protocol.authority_required: Native test/label gold and independent regret calculator.
successor_protocol.positive_gate: Both zero- and positive-regret classes occur; predicted floors and refinement closure hold under frozen stress tests.
successor_protocol.negative_or_cannot_check_terminal: No class diversity, law violation, or failed refinement yields bounded exact law only.
successor_protocol.no_rescue_rule: No family switching, price-axis repair, or distribution reweighting after outcomes.

papers.title: Responsibility-Carrying State
papers.top_tier_rejection_hypothesis: A referee can accept the transport theorem but reject empirical safety and generality because the safety endpoint is self-scored and the live-Git successor needs organization-disjoint evidence.
papers.highest_information_move: Do not duplicate #1691; complete its live-Git acquisition outside the old corpus and obtain external adjudication for safety-cost outcomes.

successor_protocol.scientific_question: Does three-valued responsibility transport prevent unsound reuse without excessive revocation across organization-disjoint repositories and externally judged safety outcomes?
successor_protocol.design: Freeze repositories outside prior 31-repo/14-org corpus; predeclare REUSABLE/non-reusable cases, head/non-head changes, abstention and safety-cost scoring.
successor_protocol.donors_and_controls: Optimistic collapse; pessimistic collapse; always-unknown; native provenance policy.
